skillFull: Flies up wielding a piping bag at given intervals. Squeezing the piping bag creates whipped cream fairies, which fly towards cakes to complete them. A large Cake appears at the end of the skill, which even more whipped cream fairies decorate. Level Up for more points for Chiffon Cake Jellies.
story:
This Cookie's sincerity when baking for another shimmers more brilliantly than anything else in Earthbread! Truly, the simplicity of her pure motivations is what makes this Cookie baked with the most basic of cake ingredients stand out among the crowd.

While at first glance you might think there's not much more to her than her fluffy chiffon texture... she may just surprise you with her super palate! One bite of a dessert, however complex it may be, and she immediately knows exactly which ingredients went into it. With this special talent, one may think she has everything it takes to make the most delicious of desserts... but because she puts her feelings above any recipe, sometimes the results have something a bit lacking.

That does not mean Angel Chiffon Cookie will give up, though! Wiping away the worries left behind by previous mistakes, she takes up her piping bag to make yet another dessert, insisting one day her desserts will make all Cookies happy. Her refusal to give up is her greatest talent, and the very one that caused her to be selected by the angel of baking!
quote: I'll make desserts that can make all Cookies happy!

lines: I... I can sense the ingredients in this dessert...!
I... I've got it! I figured out how to make this dessert!

When baking, it's the heart that counts!

A sweet dessert always helps when the world's got you feeling bitter!
I hope my desserts bring a smile to Cookies' faces!

lines: I need to get better...! I won't be able to win with my skills as they are.

I haven't been making desserts for long, but I work extra hard to make up for it!

costumes.info: Strawberries are in season, and every Cookie knows what that means—it's time for a strawberry festival! Angel Chiffon Cookie's strawberry cream cake is a huge hit, even among all the delicious strawberry desserts. Its simple exterior belies its undeniably delicious flavor, so flavorful, its(sic) almost as if a magic spell has been placed upon it... Nobody can deny Angel Chiffon Cookie's baking is truly magical!

costumes.name: Kind Like My Melody
costumes.info: Angel Chiffon Cookie wears an adorable pink strawberry hood that looks just like My Melody Cookie's! She's busy baking a special almond pound cake for friends visiting the Cookie World. All her kindness and care will be baked right into the cake, making it extra soft and fluffy!
